injury.short_comment: Mitchell (ankle) is questionable for Wednesday's game against Dallas.
Williams has been diagnosed with a dislocated left ankle and fractured fibula, which will require surgery, Shams Charania of ESPN reports.
Holmgren (knee) has been ruled out for Wednesday's game against the Mavericks.
Caruso (ankle) won't play Wednesday in Dallas.
Wallace has been diagnosed with a torn labrum in his left shoulder and will require surgery, Shams Charania of ESPN reports.
Topic (back) will remain on the inactive list for Wednesday's game in Dallas.
The Thunder plan to waive Oweh (Achilles) on Friday.
Sorber (knee) has been ruled out for Wednesday's game against the Mavericks.
